services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: We have been hosting summer camps for 15 years in Phoenixville and Master Phelan has over 20 years of experience running karate camps. Our main focus for our summer camp program is to provide a fun and enriching environment for campers. A normal week at summer camp is nothing normal. We have an action-packed schedule every week with activities that include, pool/water days, arts and crafts, karate lessons, nature walks, weekly event field trips and so much more! Wednesdays-Event field trip! Whether it's trips to the Please Touch Museum, the Zoo, or the Fun Dungeon, event field trips never disappoint!
